prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing-page composition comp for TomorrowWorks
Render a complete 1440×900 public Malaysian career guidance website viewport, edge to edge, with crisp readable text and the start of the next section. The visitor wants to enter their current role and see where it can lead.
Use this real content: brand “TomorrowWorks”; navigation “Explore careers”, “Job market”, “How it works”, “For organisations”; utility “BM / 中文”; short headline “Your experience can take you further.”; dominant working sentence “I work as [Accounting assistant]” with an unmistakable inline action “Show me where it can lead”; quiet proof “Malaysian job-market evidence · No CV required”; next section heading “One role. More than one possible future.”
Composition: Sentence First. The editable sentence is the largest functional object and stretches confidently across the middle of the page. The headline introduces it at a smaller scale. A single fine route rule leaves the field, passes one small verified marker, and descends into the next section. Keep the far right and upper field substantially open. The page must feel like a working premium product, with clear field boundaries and button affordance.
One Clear Step visual law: near-white ground, deep blue-black text, restrained forest-green action, barely warm grey rule; precise modern typography, disciplined alignment and generous space.
Do not add destination cards, suggestions, statistics, badges, photography, illustrations, dashboards, gradients, floating panels, decorative icons, AI motifs or fake logos. No browser frame or watermark.
